caption:
A chocolate brown colour palette for the quiet luxury home, every hex included.

Designers keep naming chocolate the colour of 2026. The split that makes it work: ivory walls, chocolate at furniture height, toffee wood as the bridge, one dried olive accent.

Keep the dark third low and the room holds its calm.

Save this for the sofa decision.
